recommendation: Keep this no-change audit. If CDS wants normative, canonical default StructureMap resources for each current R6 request resource type, handle that as new work rather than unfinished FHIR-11652 application.
issue_request: FHIR-11652 asked CDS to define standard transforms/StructureMaps for the basic ActivityDefinition activity categories; it was Published/Persuasive, raised against DSTU2, applied for R5, and resolved with agreement that default structure maps would be provided.
initial_application: No local source commit explicitly mentions FHIR-11652. The Jira comment points to HL7/fhir#2834, whose local merge history includes d5c8096f562da742bfcbd81943d91bcf488b8854 adding the ActivityDefinition Structure Mapping section and f0d5d69c3a16f31cbdf667090336ba87f5f77550 adding 15 companion activitydefinition-map-*.fhirmap files.
additional_context: FHIR-29210 is the later Published/Persuasive same-change-family issue that supplied the concrete Parameters-to-target FHIR Mapping Language examples and is already represented on the combined branch. Current source/fhir.ini actively includes StructureMap, ActivityDefinition, and PlanDefinition, and ActivityDefinition.transform remains a canonical StructureMap reference.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The current ActivityDefinition notes already provide FHIR Mapping Language snippets for each listed Request resource kind, and the companion .fhirmap files remain in source as supporting examples. Turning these examples into new normative HL7 canonical StructureMap resources would require a new work-group decision.
